I have a car, and my sister does not.
She lives near me, so she sometimes asks to borrow it.
Usually, she asks first, and I say yes without much thought.
Last Friday, I planned to drive to a friend's house after work.
I finished work at six and walked to where I usually park my car.
But my car wasn't there at all.
At first, I thought I was in the wrong spot.
I walked around the parking lot twice, checking every row carefully.
I still couldn't find it, and I started to worry that someone had stolen it.
My hands felt a little shaky as I dialed my sister's number.
I called my sister to tell her what happened.
She answered the phone and sounded very calm about the whole thing.
She said, "Oh, I have your car.
I forgot to tell you."
I felt relieved, but also a little annoyed at the same time.
She explained that she needed to go to the airport early that morning.
She said she tried to call me, but I didn't answer my phone.
I checked my phone, and she was right about that.
She had called twice, but I was in a meeting and didn't hear it ring.
Still, I wished she had waited for me to say yes first.
She said she was sorry and offered to bring the car back right away.
I told her it was fine, but next time, please wait for an actual answer.
She agreed and said she completely understood my point.
She arrived thirty minutes later with my car, parking it exactly where I usually leave it.
She also brought coffee for both of us, as a small way to say sorry.
We sat outside my building and talked for a while.
She told me about her trip to the airport and why it was so sudden.
Her friend needed a ride, and she didn't have time to think it through carefully.
I understood the reason, but I still teased her about it a little.
Now we have a new rule between us, one we both agreed on that evening.
She can only borrow my car if I say yes first, every single time, no exceptions.
No more surprises, even in a real emergency situation.
She agreed, but she also said I should answer my phone more often.
That part was fair too, honestly.
Since then, she has always asked first, and I always answer my phone faster now.
Our little system works well, and neither of us has been annoyed since.
